column3: MT 10:32. Close to the Hebrew; “we will leave the seventh year and the debt of every hand” is expanded to “forego the seventh year’s produce and the exacting of every debt.”
MT 10:34. Close to the Hebrew; “the bread of the row” is rendered “the showbread.”
MT 10:38. Close to the Hebrew; “all the cities of our labor” is rendered “all our farming communities.”
